plan_a_advantages: Includes a tempo run to improve lactate threshold and running speed.

reasoning: Plan A is the better choice for an athlete aiming to become a faster trail runner. While both plans incorporate rest days, Plan A includes a tempo run and a long run, which are crucial for developing speed and endurance respectively. Plan B consists almost entirely of easy runs, which, while important for building a base, won't sufficiently challenge the athlete to improve their speed or ability to handle longer distances on trails. The inclusion of cross-training in Plan A also provides a valuable recovery tool and reduces the risk of overuse injuries.
